other_runtime.name: makepad-relax
other_runtime.reason: Relax holds its own profile and differs from Noble on version-selection-boundary, held-root-mixing.
other_runtime.faithful_mapping: Noble's held root maps to a root_a call parked on a thread across the edit, its nested replacement to the edit of leaf_b, and the new root to a fresh root_a call after the edit. The transitive chain root_t -> mid_c -> leaf_d maps to Noble's transitive dispatch. Relax has no root-scoped map, so selected versions are compared, not maps or epochs.
unsupported_dimensions: stale compare-and-set, omission and retention-budget controls: Relax has no publication compare-and-set or retention budget.

anticipated_differences.noble: one immutable map pinned per root for all nested dispatch (S-LSLOT-01)
anticipated_differences.relax: reload is a source-edit transaction with explicit Refuse/Patch/Restart outcomes; no root-scoped map is implied
anticipated_differences.classification_rule: a Relax Refuse, Patch or Restart is admissible under the Relax profile and is an intentional semantic difference, never a Noble contract violation nor a Relax defect

anticipated_differences.noble: a root started before a publication keeps its pinned version
anticipated_differences.relax: a Patch may take effect in already-created state; whether an active call keeps the old code is a Relax-profile question that must be declared before measuring it
anticipated_differences.classification_rule: a difference here is recorded as intentional until the Relax profile is frozen and quoted

other_runtime.name: makepad-relax
other_runtime.reason: Relax holds its own profile and differs from Noble on retention-unit.
other_runtime.faithful_mapping: A saved Noble Program maps to a stored boxed closure and to a stored fn pointer, both saved in the first run. Replacements map to edits of leaf and make. Retention maps to calls of the stored values after later edits. Relax declares no retention quota, so Noble's quota boundary has no counterpart.

package retirement order and saved-owner tokens: Relax has no per-value owner.

anticipated_differences.classification_rule: a differing reclamation bound is an intentional semantic difference; only a stale handle that traps would be a failure under LREF-CASE-03

other_runtime.name: makepad-relax
other_runtime.faithful_mapping: Noble's abnormal effect prefix maps to the effect lines that the panicking version printed before its panic. Noble's abnormal root exit maps to Relax's rollback of the patch group and its rerun. Event relocation has no Relax counterpart.
unsupported_dimensions: event-relocation: Relax has no counterpart of Noble's relocation witness.
effect owner: Noble performs an effect for the checked target slot; a Relax effect belongs to the code that ran, so no owner correspondence is claimed.

other_runtime.name: makepad-relax
other_runtime.reason: Relax holds its own profile and differs from Noble on typed-admission.
other_runtime.faithful_mapping: Noble's negative admission families map to edits that the pinned rustc rejects: a type error, a signature change without its caller, and a borrow error. Noble's incompatible schema maps to a layout change of a struct that a thread-local holds. The admission of each candidate is compared by whether its body ran, not by message text.
unsupported_dimensions: generated typed cases and declared host bounds: the Relax lane runs one fixed sequence.
effect ceilings and nominal resource schemas: Rust has no direct counterpart.

anticipated_differences.noble: admission is an exact ordered interface plus nominal resource schema plus effect ceiling, refused before execution
anticipated_differences.relax: a reload transaction's compatibility rule is its own; no exact-interface rule is implied
anticipated_differences.classification_rule: an admitted Relax reload that Noble would refuse is a profile difference, not a defect, until a faithful mapping is declared

scenarios.title: Shared saved owners, composition ownership and a cross-module alias

unsupported_dimensions: owner tokens surviving a host process restart

other_runtime.name: makepad-relax
other_runtime.reason: Noble's saved owners are host owner tokens with release orders. Retained Relax code has no per-value owner, so this lane maps no Relax counterpart and runs nothing for this scenario.

anticipated_differences.noble: each saved Program owns its package through an explicit host owner token
anticipated_differences.relax: retained code is owned by the reload transaction, not by a saved value
anticipated_differences.classification_rule: owner-token differences are an intentional semantic difference; a double free or a stale handle is a failure in either runtime

non_claims: this comparison is experimental evidence; it is not a proof, a conformance result or a model-to-implementation correspondence claim
the authoritative Noble lanes keep their own claims; the export binds their bytes and reproduces their observations
no LSLOT-01..09 canonical case state is promoted and no evidence is attached to a canonical case
each runtime is classified under its own frozen profile; an intentional semantic difference is a defect of neither runtime, and nothing here requires Relax to implement Noble root-pinned selection
a stored Rust closure or fn pointer is not equated with an immutable Noble Program beyond the faithful mapping each column states
a failed Relax checked-before-execution policy is an observation of that Relax admission setting, not a Noble defect
compiler-lab derives and replay-verifies the Relax observations; this corpus binds and cross-checks them and does not re-derive them from the raw streams
timing and memory samples are bounded observations bound to their scenario, revision and admission outcome, not benchmarks
